description.value: Revolution Cycles is Rossland's dedicated full-service bike shop, operating for 21 years with an open-concept workshop staffed by certified mechanics and stocked by major brands including Giant, Santa Cruz, Yeti, Devinci, and Rocky Mountain. As a certified Shimano Service Center, the shop covers everything from wheel builds to custom suspension setups. They also offer mountain bike and e-MTB rentals and coaching and guiding services, making them a comprehensive resource for cyclists exploring this renowned mountain biking destination.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms Revolution Cycles is a long-established (21-year) full-service bike shop in Rossland with an open-concept workshop, experienced mechanics, bike rentals, and coaching/guiding. Touring-relevant parts (pannier racks, bikepacking gear, lights, fenders, locks) are listed explicitly in the store navigation. The rental page and about page confirm e-bike sales and service, MTB and e-MTB rentals, and guided riding. OSM lacks a phone number but the website prominently lists both a toll-free (1-888-296-5688) and a local number (250-362-5688); address matches OSM exactly.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website lists toll-free 1-888-296-5688 and a local number 250-362-5688 (from the rental page). Phone field populated from website; contact_confirmed.phone set to null as OSM had no value to cross-check.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established, full-service dedicated bike shop in a major BC cycling destination with 21 years of operation, confirmed repairs, rentals, touring parts, e-bike service, and guided rides — high value for touring cyclists.

Touring parts stocked.detail: Store navigation explicitly lists pannier racks, bikepacking gear, bottle cages, lights, locks, and fenders as stocked accessory categories

E-bike service.detail: Website lists 'E-bike Parts' as a dedicated parts category; shop sells e-bikes and rents Rocky Mountain PowerPlay e-MTBs, implying service capability

Bike rentals.detail: Dedicated rental page confirms full-suspension MTB (Devinci Troy, new 2026 fleet) and e-MTB (Rocky Mountain PowerPlay in four sizes) available for 24-hr or multi-day rental

Guided rides.detail: 'Coaching and Guiding' is listed as a dedicated page in the site footer navigation
